caption: The drawing depicts three distinct botanical objects arranged near the center of a cream-colored background. The top object is a brown, circular acorn cap viewed from above, showing a concentric pattern and a small circular bump in the center. Below it is a complete acorn consisting of a textured, dark brown cap fitting onto a smooth, shiny, light brown nut with a pointed tip. To the right of the acorn is a small, cylindrical cup, colored light brown with detailed patterning resembling a woven or scaly surface. All objects are drawn with clear, realistic textures and subtle shading. The name "David P Willoughby" is written in red near the objects.
title: Thimble Case
